Our doors

A door for every entrance.

Wooden Doors

Solid teak, sheesham and engineered wood doors — hand-finished for warmth, grain and lasting strength.

Designer Doors

Statement entrances with custom carving, panelling and inlays — designed around your home's character.

Security Doors

Steel-core and reinforced doors with premium locks — uncompromising safety without sacrificing style.

Flush & Laminate

Clean, modern flush doors in a wide range of laminates and finishes — perfect for interiors at any budget.

PVC & WPC

Waterproof, termite-proof doors ideal for bathrooms and wet areas — durable and virtually maintenance-free.

Frames & Fittings

Matching door frames, chowkhats, handles and hardware — a complete, fitted solution from one place.
